subject: Security evidence mapping + calendar ops for SOC2/DPA review
content:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Hsu <daniel.hsu@bluewave.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security evidence mapping + calendar ops for SOC2/DPA review

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for agreeing to run through the SOC 2 evidence mapping and a narrow DPA/pen-test orientation next week. To make the call productive, I pulled together a short evidence matrix that maps the artifacts we'll need (logs, configs, policies) and which team will present them. Please find the draft attached (evidence-matrix.xlsx).

Ask: can you confirm which timezone your security team will join from and whether you prefer a 45- or 60-minute slot? We suggest the following windows (PDT):
- Tues 2027-05-25 10:00–10:45 
- Tues 2027-05-25 14:00–15:00 
- Wed 2027-05-26 08:30–09:30

We want to include our pen-test vendor for the DPA/pen scope discussion for ~15 minutes at the end. Marcus — can you share the short vendor intake form I mentioned? Grace — will you be the lead on the evidence walkthrough?

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
Redwood Inference

Attachment: evidence-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB)

--
From: Daniel Hsu <daniel.hsu@bluewave.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 07:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security evidence mapping + calendar ops for SOC2/DPA review

Hi Ava —

Appreciate the matrix. Our security folks are on Pacific as well (mostly SFO). The 14:00–15:00 slot on Tue (5/25) is the best for the wider team; 45 minutes would work if we keep the pen-test vendor to a strict 15-minute segment.

Two quick asks from our side:
1) Can Redwood share a short agenda with presenters and timestamps so our engineering leads can prep?
2) For pen-test coordination, our procurement requires the vendor statement of work and a point of contact — can your vendor share an intake or SoW doc?

I'll pencil the Tue 14:00 slot but can you send a calendar invite with the agenda?

Thanks,
Daniel Hsu
Director, Security Engineering
BlueWave Finance

--
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Hsu <daniel.hsu@bluewave.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, RedShield PenTest <pentest@redshield.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security evidence mapping + calendar ops for SOC2/DPA review

Thanks Daniel — locking Tue 5/25 14:00–15:00 PDT. Calendar invite is attached to follow; agenda and presenter timestamps are below. I also attached our vendor intake doc that RedShield requested (redshield-intake-form.pdf) and a short SoW summary (docusign-scopes.pdf).

Agenda (45 minutes total)
- 14:00–14:05 Introductions + meeting goals (Ava)
- 14:05–14:20 Evidence mapping by domain (Grace) — logs, retention, encryption keys, access control
- 14:20–14:35 Architecture & runtime controls (Marcus) — serving runtime, KV cache policies, routing/fallbacks
- 14:35–14:50 Pen-test scope & logistics (RedShield rep) — 10–15 minutes + Q&A

RedShield: could you confirm who will present and a single POC name/email for procurement?

Daniel — once you confirm, I will send the calendar invite and include the Drive folder link with artifact examples.

Best,
Ava

Attachment: redshield-intake-form.pdf (PDF, 28KB)
Attachment: docusign-scopes.pdf (PDF, 9KB)
